Remarks

The signature and the trust chain are validated on the REST PKI service, so no key or licence is kept locally.

Properties

AccessToken

Access token generated in the REST PKI console. Server-side only — it is never exposed to the client.

public string AccessToken { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Endpoint

Endpoint of the REST PKI service. Defaults to Lacuna's cloud.

public string Endpoint { get; set; }

Property Value

string

PadesSignaturePolicy

Which policy a PDF is signed under: BasicPadesSignaturePolicy (the default) or the id of another PAdES signature policy REST PKI knows. Only document signing reads it.

public string PadesSignaturePolicy { get; set; }

Property Value

string

SecurityContext

Which roots a certificate must chain to: PkiBrazilSecurityContext (the default), LacunaTestSecurityContext, or the id of a security context created in the REST PKI console.

public string SecurityContext { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

LacunaTestSecurityContext accepts certificates anyone can issue. Use it in development only.

GetSecurityContextId()

Resolves SecurityContext to the id REST PKI expects.

public Guid GetSecurityContextId()

Returns

Guid

The security context id.

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

SecurityContext is neither a known name nor an id. An unknown value is refused instead of falling back, so a typo never changes which roots are trusted.
